description: This Java class configures a batch job for adding accrual entries in the loan account processing of the Fineract system. It defines Spring Batch components such as a job and a step, wiring the necessary tasklet and transaction management.

classes.name: AddAccrualEntriesConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up a batch job for adding accrual entries, defining the job steps and wiring dependencies.

methods.name: addAccrualEntriesStep
methods.description: Creates a batch Step for executing the AddAccrualEntriesTasklet, utilizing injected jobRepository and transactionManager.

methods.name: addAccrualEntriesJob
methods.description: Defines the batch Job that runs the addAccrualEntriesStep, with an incrementer for job runs.
